content_check.equivalence_derivation: L(t,tdot,xdot) = (tdot^2 + xdot^T Q(t) xdot)/2. Since y^T P^{-1} y = sup_p (2p^T y - p^T P p), concavity of P(t) makes y^T Q(t) y a supremum of functions convex in (t,y), hence jointly convex. Conversely, by Rockafellar Thm 33.1 the partial conjugate H(t,p) = p^T P(t) p / 2 of a jointly convex L is concave in t. So 'concave cometric' is exactly 'jointly convex geodesic Lagrangian' = 'Hamiltonian concave in position, convex in momentum' (Rockafellar's concave-convex class). 358's E_[a,c](V) is literally the second derivative of the coordinate energy along affine variations (t+rw, x+rz), so E >= 0 is the second-order form of joint convexity. 358 verifies it by direct computation and does not name convexity of the Lagrangian.

candidates.name: Returning-passage free-endpoint index estimate
paper_items: P13 domination inequality |P'p|^2 <= C delta p^T(-P'')p
candidates.statement: For all sufficiently small delta, every returning neck passage [0,L] and every smooth field V (no endpoint condition) satisfy I^perp_[0,L](V) >= 0, uniformly in the entry angle, turning height and duration L. Proof: a gauge makes w(0)=w(L)=0 and <V,T> affine. The boundary Christoffel term then gives mu(e^T Delta z)^2. Cauchy-Schwarz in L^2(Q)+H_0^1 and a Schur complement reduce the claim to S(p,p) - S(p,e)^2/(S(e,e)+1/mu) <= L, which is closed by three S-bounds and a strict timing margin beta < 1.

candidates.name: Concave cometric => nonnegative coordinate second variation, with an engineered nonnegative boundary term
paper_items: P20 lem:coordinate-index: I = E - [<T,Gamma(V,V)>], Gamma(V,V) = (kappa/2) z1^2 d_tau at the ends
P18 conservation p=Q xdot, F = p^T P p concave
candidates.statement: For g = dt^2 + dx^T Q(t) dx with P = Q^{-1} concave, the second derivative of energy along coordinate-affine variations equals E = int(wdot^2 + |zdot - P'p w|_Q^2 - F'' w^2/2), a sum of nonnegative terms. The intrinsic index is I = E - [<T,Gamma(V,V)>]. Because P'(0) = kappa e1 e1^T at both ends, the endpoint term is >= 0 at every entry and exit when w = 0 there.

family_D.label: D2
family_D.rests_on: C1 (returning-passage estimate), C2 (concave-cometric convexity bridge) and C3 (concave neck construction), all N2. No item passes all of Tests 1-3 cleanly. C1 fails Test 2 (goal-shaped strengthening). C2's core fails Test 1 (it is Rockafellar/Kiefer-Lieb-Ruskai convexity). C3 has close variants and is a hypothesis-driven gadget.
family_D.falls_to: It would RISE to D3 (F5, cluster C2+C3) only if (i) an expert confirms that no prior Riemannian construction certifies no conjugate points through a jointly convex coordinate Lagrangian / concave cometric, AND (ii) Test 4 (P-C2 open arm and P-C3) gives a hit rate below the calibrated threshold. That is the same coupling argument used for 287's cluster. It would FALL to D1 only if a prior concave-inverse-metric neck construction is found AND C1 is judged a routine estimate (N1). Both seem unlikely.
family_D.not_transfer: The central idea is transfer (convex analysis / calculus of variations -> Riemannian no-conjugate-points), so it cannot by itself give D3 (PLAN: cross-field transfer alone never yields D3). Any D3 claim must rest on the coupling with the bespoke neck (C3) and the uniform returning estimate (C1).
family_D.analyst_comparison: family.json gave provisional D3 at low confidence on P29 'N3 weak'. This pass withdraws it: P29 is a localised strengthening of the goal predicate with an elementary proof. family.json itself flagged this risk ('drops to D2 if a judge calls that item N2').
family_D.result_vs_machinery_note: This is a significant result: it answers IK Q1.1/8.1 and BM Q4.1.2, open since 2012-2013, negatively in dimension 3. The machinery is N2 throughout. The hardness appears to lie in choosing an architecture (neck + convexity certificate + free-endpoint passage estimates) rather than in one non-analytic item. Positive evidence that it was hard: the question stayed open for 13+ years despite expert attention (IK, BM, Tchuiaga 2025 worked nearby).
family_D.correctness_caveat: The analyst re-derived the key identities and found no gap. Lean has 0 sorry/axiom and imports only Mathlib, but it was NOT built here. Unrefereed. All grades are conditional on correctness.

provenance_flag.explanation: All 8 bibliography entries date from 1963-2021 (BurnsMatveev2021 is the ETDS version of arXiv:1308.5417, v1 2013) and predate LLM assistance. The arXiv abstract pages of IK (1205.4455), BM (1308.5417) and Leeb (dg-ga/9410002) carry no AI statement. The paper cites no 2025-2026 work. The only 2025-2026 items found on the topic (Tchuiaga arXiv:2504.07616; Pardo-Guerra-Washburn arXiv:2607.22594) disclose no AI use on their abstract pages, are not cited, and contain none of the candidates. WebSearch for the problem with 'ChatGPT', 'GPT-5', 'OpenAI' or 'AI-assisted' found no model-produced prior work and no prior resolution. The 358 preprint itself is authored 'OpenAI' (release README), so it is model-produced; that is the object under study, not a precedent.

bridge_novelty.import: Convex analysis / calculus of variations: a jointly convex Lagrangian (equivalently a Hamiltonian concave in position) has nonnegative second variation; matrix-fractional joint convexity
bridge_novelty.evidence: 358 does not cite it. Searches for convex-Lagrangian or concave-Hamiltonian criteria for no conjugate points in Riemannian constructions returned only dynamics papers that assume no conjugate points (CIPP 1999, Lee 2012). Known constructions with positive curvature and no conjugate points (Gulliver 1975; Ballmann-Brin-Burns 1987; Eptaminitakis-Graham 2019) use radial/Riccati comparison. Caveat: the underlying implication is textbook, so an expert may know folklore uses (e.g. for Liouville/warped metrics). In 2D the criterion forces K <= 0, which may explain why it was not used before.

bridge_novelty.import: CAT(0) metric geometry: flat torus theorem, minsets and axis shifts (BH II.6-II.7)
bridge_novelty.evidence: Leeb 1995 Example 4.1 and Kapovich-Leeb 1996 use exactly this route, and the paper says so.

bridge_novelty.import: Hyperbolic surfaces (punctured torus with cusp, Bonahon 5.5)
bridge_novelty.evidence: Standard in graph-manifold metric constructions (Leeb 1995 Thm 3.2 uses hyperbolic base orbifolds).

bridge_novelty.import: Hilbert-space duality (H_0^1 dual norm, Riesz), Schur complement
bridge_novelty.evidence: These are generic analytic tools, and Lean replaces them with a pointwise quadratic. Not a field-level bridge.

bridge_novelty.import: (Lean) Morse-Hedlund / Hadamard-Cartan for no conjugate points
bridge_novelty.evidence: A classical consequence. The new element is only its use to bypass van Kampen.

common.models: Training-data cutoff strictly before 2026-09-24 (358 preprint date), with no exposure to the openai/math release (2026-10-06). No model-produced precedent exists, so this is the only date constraint. Canary probe: ask whether IK Q1.1/8.1 has been answered and what a 'concave cometric' neck is; exclude any model that recognises the 358 construction. No browsing, retrieval or tools. Run the OpenAI model(s) that produced 358 only as an uncontrolled upper-reference arm. The judge must differ from the proposer.
common.context_L: Mathlib d13f23b (digest: Riemannian/inner-product API, ConvexOn, Loewner order Matrix.PosSemidef, intervalIntegral, ODE uniqueness) plus 358's 8 bibliography entries (abstracts plus the invoked statements: BH II.6.8/II.7.1/II.1A.6, Leeb Ex. 4.1, Milnor Secs. 13-15, IK Thm 7.1, Bonahon 5.5, Gulliver Sec. 3).

arms.L+: adds Rockafellar 1970 / Convex Analysis Thm 33.1 and the matrix-fractional lemma, to measure how much having the transfer source in context raises C2 hits
arms.open: problem statement only (IK Q8.1 in dimension 3), no direction
arms.directed: states the architecture: Leeb Example 4.1 manifold; NPC pieces; a neck dt^2 + dx^T Q(t) dx between the two flat structures; certify no conjugate points by index-form estimates

common.sampling: n = 256 independent samples per arm, temperature 1.0, fixed reasoning budget (e.g. 32k tokens). Unbiased pass@k for k in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256}; K = 256.
common.judging: Two independent LLM judges, given the neighbour lists from this file and the paper's own wording (introduction.tex:68-96). A differential geometer checks all hits and 10% of misses. Lean equivalence where possible (Neck.coordinateEnergyDensity, ReturningPassage.energy_nonnegative, returning_arbitrary_field_nonnegative). Partial credit is recorded, not counted.
common.controls: Positive: Cook-Reckhow ER extension variables for PHP. Negative: C4 (passage localisation) and C7 (Leeb obstruction) in the same format.
common.prompt_template: Problem: Is there a closed 3-manifold that admits a Riemannian metric without conjugate points but no metric of nonpositive sectional curvature? Library: [L digest]. [directed: Strategy: take the graph manifold of Leeb Example 4.1 with gluing h2=h1+f1, f2=h1; use NPC product pieces and insert a neck [0,1] x T^2 with metric dt^2 + dx^T Q(t) dx.] Established results you may use: [non-hidden upstream items]. Propose the single most useful new condition, lemma or construction, stated precisely, with a proof sketch.

P-C2.item: C2 concave cometric => E >= 0, plus the boundary-term sign

P-C2.arm_A: directed + L: given the neck ansatz, ask for a pointwise condition on Q(t) that makes the second variation along every neck geodesic nonnegative up to boundary terms
P-C2.arm_B: open + L (decisive for the C2+C3 cluster)
P-C2.equivalence: Hit: any condition equivalent to concavity of Q(t)^{-1} in t (or to joint convexity of y^T Q(t) y in (t,y), or to a Hamiltonian concave in t), together with the coordinate-affine second variation. Partial: 'Lagrangian convex in (position, velocity)' stated with no condition on Q.

P-C3.hide: P05, P10, P11, P13 and downstream
P-C3.give: C2 (with the boundary-sign requirement P'(0) = kappa e1e1^T >= 0 at both ends), Leeb's manifold and the gluing
P-C3.equivalence: Hit: an explicit smooth path P on [0,1] with -P'' >= 0, exact product germs at both ends with end slope a positive multiple of e1e1^T in each end frame, realising the integral gluing (by a period choice or an equivalent normalisation). Lean check: Cometric.uniform_cometric_bounds-type statement. Linear interpolation alone is a miss (it violates the end germs).
